MODELS AND THINKING

          
Saver uses Sonnet for everything, so slides arrive fastest and use the least of your plan. Balanced and Max quality use Opus for most jobs: better explanations, but slower, and the voice may wait longer before each slide. Each job below can also be set on its own.
